sources.title: Using UK greenhouse gas inventory data in UK ETS monitoring and reporting: the country-specific factor list
facts: DESNZ published 2026 carbon emission factors and calorific values from the UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory on 24 July 2026.
The factors may be used only in circumstances allowed by an installation's approved monitoring plan and are not parcel measurements.

sources.title: Emissions and targets for installations registered as hospitals or small emitters, 2021 to 2025
facts: The DESNZ transparency dataset lists HSE installations, annual emissions targets and actual emissions for scheme years 2021 to 2025.
Installation-level HSE emissions remain installation/scheme data and are not automatically bound to a canonical land parcel.

sources.title: UK ETS: Waste quarterly data report template (Q2)
facts: The Q2 template is for waste operators submitting quarterly data during the voluntary UK ETS MRV period.
A reporting template or submitted workflow does not by itself prove a verified parcel greenhouse-gas value.

sources.title: Regional and local authority gas consumption statistics
facts: DESNZ publishes accredited gas-consumption estimates for Great Britain by region and local authority, including domestic, non-domestic and total consumption.
Gas consumption is activity data and must not be substituted for greenhouse-gas emissions without an explicit supported calculation method.

sources.title: Subnational gas consumption data collection
facts: The DESNZ collection links methodology, local authority, LSOA/MSOA, postcode, stacked-gas and off-gas-grid products.
Different geography and processing products must remain distinct and cannot be treated as parcel measurements by default.

sources.title: Postcode level gas statistics: 2024
facts: DESNZ publishes 2024 domestic gas consumption statistics at postcode level for England, Scotland and Wales.
A postcode aggregate does not identify consumption or emissions for an individual canonical parcel.

sources.title: Subnational methodology and guidance
facts: The DESNZ methodology describes collection, compilation, coverage, limitations and comparability of subnational energy estimates.
Methodology evidence constrains interpretation but is not an observed emissions row.

sources.title: Overview of weather correction of gas industry consumption data
facts: The official note explains weather correction of gas meter-point Annual Quantity data used in subnational consumption statistics.
Weather-corrected consumption must not be confused with raw consumption or with measured greenhouse-gas emissions.

sources.title: Subnational electricity and gas consumption summary report 2024
facts: The accredited report presents annual subnational electricity and weather-corrected gas consumption with latest estimates for 2024.
The report uses meter-point administrative data and explicitly distinguishes consumption from other energy-statistics scopes.

sources.title: Lower and Middle Super Output Areas gas consumption
facts: DESNZ publishes LSOA and MSOA gas-consumption products updated to include 2024 data and a correction to affected 2023 non-domestic data.
LSOA/MSOA aggregates are not parcel-level measurements.

sources.title: Stacked gas consumption statistics data
facts: The stacked dataset provides region, local-authority, MSOA and LSOA gas time series through 2024 and records revision notices.
Historical revisions and geography must be preserved when using the data.

sources.title: Subnational estimates of properties not connected to the gas network
facts: DESNZ estimates domestic properties not connected to the gas grid from property counts and domestic gas meters.
An off-gas-grid estimate is not an emissions measurement and does not imply a fuel or emissions value for a parcel.

sources.title: MSOA estimates of properties not connected to the gas network
facts: The official statistics provide MSOA-level estimates of domestic properties not connected to the gas grid through 2024.
MSOA off-gas estimates cannot be assigned directly to individual parcels.

sources.title: LSOA estimates of properties not connected to the gas network
facts: The official statistics provide LSOA-level estimates of domestic properties not connected to the gas grid through 2024.
LSOA off-gas status is an area estimate, not a verified property or parcel emissions observation.

sources.title: Parliamentary constituency estimates of properties not connected to the gas network
facts: DESNZ provides parliamentary-constituency estimates of properties not connected to the gas grid through 2024.
Constituency statistics are aggregate estimates and do not establish parcel-level gas use or emissions.

sources.title: ONS domestic gas consumption local statistics indicator
facts: ONS exposes a local-statistics indicator for median domestic gas consumption using DESNZ data through 2024.
A local-authority median is a statistical summary and cannot be interpreted as consumption or emissions for a specific parcel.

sources.title: National Data Library: Sub-national gas consumption
facts: The National Data Library surface republishes DESNZ accredited sub-national gas-consumption resources under the Open Government Licence.
Dataset catalogue metadata and consumption resources remain aggregate activity evidence, not parcel emissions.

sources.title: Sub-national total final energy consumption during 2024 announcement
facts: DESNZ schedules the 2024 sub-national total final energy consumption release for 30 July 2026 at 09:30.
As of 26 July 2026 the release is future metadata only; unreleased values are not treated as observed.

sources.title: Sub-national gas consumption in 2024 announcement
facts: The announcement records the confirmed 18 December 2025 release of local-authority gas consumption for 2024.
Release metadata confirms timing but does not itself provide parcel-level values.

sources.title: Conversion factors 2026: statement of voluntary compliance with the Code of Practice for Statistics
facts: DESNZ states that the annual greenhouse-gas company-reporting conversion factors are produced against the Code of Practice pillars of trustworthiness, quality and value.
A quality statement validates publication practice but is not an emissions measurement.

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for hospital or small emitters: how to comply
facts: Current Environment Agency/DESNZ guidance requires HSE operators to monitor and report annual emissions under their approved monitoring plan and scheme deadlines.
HSE targets, reported emissions and default factors have specific scheme-year and installation scope and are not parcel measurements by default.

sources.title: Get a carbon pricing verification form
facts: HMRC guidance requires a completed independently verified carbon-pricing verification form for relevant CBAM carbon-price relief claims.
A carbon-pricing verification form concerns qualifying carbon-price treatment and must not be substituted for a UK parcel greenhouse-gas measurement.

sources.title: Work out your Carbon Price Relief
facts: HMRC guidance describes calculation of Carbon Price Relief using effective carbon prices and embodied emissions subject to qualifying pricing schemes.
A monetary carbon-price relief calculation is not a physical parcel emissions observation.

sources.title: Claiming Carbon Price Relief for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
facts: The HMRC collection sets out eligibility, verification and calculation steps for CBAM Carbon Price Relief.
CBAM embodied-emissions and carbon-price evidence has product/import scope and is not evidence of emissions from a land parcel in England.
